sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 280. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Removes status ailments.
-Target: all allies. Removes debuffs and special debuffs.
-Target: all enemies (NPCs). Decreases action speed by 60 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Cost recovery speed reduced by 10 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies excluding yourself. Increases all stats by 80% for 120 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies hero for 60 seconds (increases max HP and all stats by 100%; nullifies debuffs, status ailments, and Unison gauge reduction; nullifies buffs [Demerit]; reduces healing effects received by 70% [Demerit]).
-Applies Star Element to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Boosts stats of star Monsters by 30% when equipped in the Main Slot.
